proved: fixed fetches bind to a route-configuration digest and never invoke the public fetch dependency
company names, domains and topic terms must appear in fresh bounded public evidence before R50 prepares them
source and redirect URLs must be credential-free HTTPS without query strings, fragments, local names or address literals
the fetch dependency must attest that DNS and network routing stayed public
responses are limited to successful textual content, four sources, 128 KiB per source and five minutes of freshness
transport errors become a bounded failure rather than leaking internal detail
the result retains source-locator, final-locator and content digests instead of response bodies or raw source URLs
R50 still rejects private fields nested inside an otherwise valid admission
residual: The pure module relies on a future hardened fetch adapter for verified_public_route. Tests use a fake dependency and make no live network claim.
next_gate: Compose R52 admission, R50 preparation and R51 receipt commands in one dormant operation contract without calling a provider.
not_authorized: live web fetching or research-provider calls
